title: Verify: No stale round or execution data after a 401 and token re-entry
summary: Unit test that the gate hides round and execution content after a 401.
description: Add tests to the adminActions test file with the same fetch stub and fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: After a 401 no 'Execution' region is rendered.
After re-entry the data is loaded again from the new responses.

steps.action: With the approve action returning 401, click Approve and assert queryByRole('region',{name:'Execution'}) is null while the Admin token field is shown.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "hides execution region"

steps.action: After the 401, call enterToken('secret') and assert findByRole('region',{name:'Execution'}) appears and the number of fetch calls to the executions URL has increased.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "re-entry reloads data"
